record.oneLiner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud provides powerful REST and JWT-authenticated APIs for managing ecommerce storefronts and administrative functions, complemented by an official B2C MCP server.
record.verdictReason: Salesforce Commerce Cloud APIs are fully documented and offer robust capabilities with an official MCP server, but API credentials and sandbox environments require Salesforce partner or enterprise enterprise-sales onboarding (partnerGated), preventing self-serve developer signup.

evidence.quote: Both the Admin and Shopper APIs are authorized using an access token in the form of a JSON Web Token (JWT).
| Admin API token | Create an API client in Account Manager (guide), then POST to oauth2/access_token. |
For a runnable example that fetches a token and calls an endpoint, see Make Your First Request.

- B2C MCP: Connect your assistant to B2C Commerce tools, official documentation search, and workflow skills. Investigate issues, debug live cartridge code, or work with B2C Commerce data through SCAPI Admin APIs.
